description: Nudol direct-ascent missile destroyed the defunct Soviet satellite Kosmos 1408 at about 470 km.
reaction: US military condemned the test as 'deliberate disregard for the security, safety, stability, and long-term sustainability of the space domain'; Russian MFA said the debris 'posed no threat'.

target: US / Viasat KA-SAT network (ground segment, user modems)
description: About an hour before the invasion of Ukraine, an attacker entered the KA-SAT management network through a misconfigured VPN and wiped user modems with the AcidRain malware.
reaction: USA, UK and EU publicly attributed the attack to Russia in May 2022.
consequences: Tens of thousands of modems in Ukraine and Europe knocked offline; Ukrainian government and military lost satellite links; about one-fifth of wind turbines and internet users across Central Europe affected (CSIS 2023).

note: Ongoing campaign 2022-2026 kept as one record. No official US protest found: a State Dept official called satellite jamming normal in wartime (Breaking Defense, Mar 2022); DoD and Space Force only said the jamming failed.
actor: RU armed forces (EW systems incl. Tobol, Kalinka)
description: Russia jammed Starlink terminals in Ukraine from March 2022; SpaceX countered with software updates. Ukrainian units had outages in May 2024 attributed to Russian EW tests; Russia announced the Kalinka system to detect and disrupt Starlink in Dec 2024.
reaction: US DoD official publicly described how SpaceX defeated the jamming (Breaking Defense, 20 Apr 2022).
consequences: Temporary outages; mostly mitigated by software updates; CSIS 2025: Russian efforts 'largely stymied'.
sources: SWF 2026 s.2.3 and cyber chapter; CSIS 2023; CSIS 2025; Insinna, Breaking Defense 2022-04-20

note: GPS is a US government system, but no official US reaction found; reactions came from European governments, EU ministers and ICAO. Added to Section 4.3 of the team report (tracked change, 23 Nov 2026).
description: Russian jamming and spoofing of GPS in Ukraine since the invasion and over the Baltic since late 2023, affecting US-supplied weapons and civil aviation.
reaction: European governments; letter of 17 EU ministers (Jun 2025); ICAO resolution (Oct 2025) found Russian GNSS interference infringed the Chicago Convention.
consequences: Hit rate of JDAM guidance kits about 60 % for most of 2023; GMLRS rockets fired by HIMARS launchers at times missed targets by 50 feet; thousands of aviation interference cases per month in the Baltic states and Poland (e.g. 2,732 in Poland in Jan 2025); flight suspensions (Finnair to Tartu, Apr 2024).
